name: Zorra Berradeira
body:
Zorra Berradeira
CR 4

This fox is covered in a coat of fur that constantly shifts from silver to gray to coppery-gold, as do the feathers of the small wings sprouting from its shoulders.

XP 1,200
NE Small magical beast
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +4 natural, +1 size)
hp 37 (5d10+10)
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +7; SR 15

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (average)
Melee bite +8 (1d8-2 plus 3d6 negative energy)
Special Attacks wicked call
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +8)

1/day—shadow body

STATISTICS

Str 7, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 8, Wis 16, Cha 7
Base Atk +5; CMB +2; CMD 14 (18 vs. trip)
Feats Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +8, Perception +11, Stealth +13, Survival +11
Languages Common (cannot speak)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Wicked Call (Su)

Once per minute as a standard action, a zorra berradeira can cry out. Each creature other than zorra berradeiras in a 60-foot-radius spread must succeed at a DC 15 Will save or take a -2 penalty on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute. This is a curse effect. The save DC is Wisdom-based.

ABOUT

The zorra berradeira, or “yelling fox,” appears at first to be an ordinary fox of majestic size. Some say it is a wandering soul, given a new form, which would explain its cunning. The zorra calls loudly throughout the day, intensifying its cries at noon and midnight. If it is interrupted in its keening, it responds aggressively. According to tales, if offended, it will pursue its enemy until the end of their days.
